CHAPTER.VERS: Jehovah reigns and he is clothed with majesty. Jehovah has girded himself with strength. The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.
Your throne is established from of old. You are from everlasting.
The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their pounding waves.
Jehovah on high is mightier than the noise of many waters. Yes he is mightier than the mighty waves of the sea.
Your testimonies are very sure: holiness adorns your house, O Jehovah, forever.
